ex.en: The young scientist was thrilled to learn that her paper had been accepted by the journal.
ex.zh: 得知论文被期刊录用，这位年轻科学家兴奋不已。

senses: n. [C] (尤指关于罪案或间谍的)惊险小说(或戏剧、电影)
n. 惊悚小说(或电影、戏剧)

ex.en: The novel is a fast-paced political thriller set in Washington.
ex.zh: 这部小说是一部以华盛顿为背景、节奏明快的政治惊悚小说。

ex.en: His latest thriller has topped the bestseller lists for weeks.
ex.zh: 他最新的惊悚小说已连续数周位居畅销书榜首。

ex.en: The film combines romance with the suspense of a classic thriller.
ex.zh: 这部电影将爱情与经典惊悚片的悬念结合在一起。

senses: vi. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长
vi. 茁壮成长；兴旺，繁荣
thrive.usage: [近] flourish vi. 繁荣；boom vi. 迅速发展；近义：flourish vi. 繁荣，兴旺；flourish 的近义词；thrive 指艰苦环境中茁壮成长;prosper 尤指国家或个人兴旺;flourish 指繁荣、处于繁盛时期；v.茁壮成长，兴旺，繁荣；adj.欣欣向荣的，兴旺的；thr（thr

ex.en: New businesses thrive in this area.
ex.zh: 新企业在这一地区蓬勃兴起。

ex.en: Some plants thrive in poor soil where more delicate species quickly die.
ex.zh: 有些植物在贫瘠的土壤中也能茁壮生长，而娇弱的物种则很快死去。

ex.en: Local craft businesses thrive on the tourists who visit the old town every summer.
ex.zh: 当地的手工艺生意依靠每年夏天来老城游览的游客而兴旺。

ex.en: A sore throat and a mild fever are the earliest symptoms of the infection.
ex.zh: 咽喉痛和低烧是这种感染最早的症状。

ex.en: The young prince will inherit the throne when the king dies.
ex.zh: 国王去世后，年轻的王子将继承王位。

ex.en: He gave up the throne in favor of his younger brother.
ex.zh: 他放弃王位，让位给弟弟。

ex.en: Rebels attempted to seize the throne during the winter riots.
ex.zh: 叛乱者企图在冬季骚乱中夺取王位。

senses: prep. 穿过；贯穿；自始至终；通过
prep. 穿过,通过,从开始到结束
adv./adj. 从头到尾;直达的,直通的
prep. 一直到；凭借；穿过；贯穿
through.usage: 小记：live through 度过；carry through 贯彻；work through 反复思考解决；break through 突破；索引p418

ex.en: However, Obamacare has allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance through Medicaid or the exchanges.
ex.zh: 然而，奥巴马医改已经让1,200多万人通过医疗补助计划或（医保）交易所获得医保。

ex.en: The sunlight poured through the tall windows of the hall.
ex.zh: 阳光透过大厅高大的窗户倾泻进来。

ex.en: She read through the contract twice before signing it.
ex.zh: 签字前她把合同通读了两遍。

senses: prep. 自始至终；贯穿整个时期
throughout.usage: [近]across prep. 在……各处；遍及；[近]through prep. 自始至终；索引p418

ex.en: This is a skill that will help them all throughout life.
ex.zh: 这是一个会使他们终生受用的技能。

ex.en: The festival attracts visitors from throughout the country.
ex.zh: 这个节日吸引着来自全国各地的游客。

ex.en: The temperature remained above 35 degrees throughout the week.
ex.zh: 整个星期气温一直保持在 35 摄氏度以上。

senses: vt. 摔；猛推；使陷入（某种状态）
throw.usage: 词组throw about到处扔;舞动(手脚等);throw away扔掉,抛弃;throw up呕吐,吐出

ex.en: The discovery threw new light on the origins of writing.
ex.zh: 这一发现为文字的起源提供了新的认识。

thrust.usage: 词组thrust...on/upon sb.迫使某人同意或接受;派生thruster n.抢先的人(为赢得优势等)

ex.en: After the scandal, the young minister was thrust into the media spotlight.
ex.zh: 丑闻之后，这位年轻部长被推到了媒体的聚光灯下。

phrases.m: 在某人的支配下,在某人的势力下

ex.en: Young people increasingly scroll through news with a flick of the thumb.
ex.zh: 年轻人越来越多地用拇指轻划来浏览新闻。

ex.en: Hearing a dull thump from upstairs, he paused his work and went up to check.
ex.zh: 听到楼上传来沉闷的砰的一声，他停下工作上去查看。

senses: v. 打雷,雷鸣;大声说,吼叫

ex.en: We heard distant thunder as the storm approached the coast.
ex.zh: 风暴逼近海岸时，我们听到了远处的雷声。

ex.en: The committee meets every Thursday to review new funding applications.
ex.zh: 委员会每周四开会审议新的经费申请。

ex.en: The report will be released on Thursday, according to an official statement.
ex.zh: 据官方声明，报告将于周四发布。

senses: adv. 因而,从而,这样,如此
thus.usage: 【记】他提的这个（this）建议很可行，因此（thus）我们可以在生活中践行它。近义词：hence, therefore。；adv.因此；以此种方式

ex.en: The evidence is incomplete; thus, no firm conclusion can be drawn.
ex.zh: 证据不完整，因此无法得出确凿的结论。

ex.en: Costs have fallen sharply and thus smaller firms can now enter the market.
ex.zh: 成本大幅下降，因此小公司现在也能进入市场。

ex.en: Thus the committee decided to postpone the vote.
ex.zh: 因此，委员会决定推迟表决。

ex.en: The country's economic growth slowed sharply despite continued government spending.
ex.zh: 尽管政府持续支出，该国经济增长仍急剧放缓。

senses: n. (核对账目等时画的)记号
v. 发出滴答声;给……标记号

ex.en: The clock ticked quietly in the empty room.
ex.zh: 空房间里时钟滴答作响。

ex.en: Put a tick next to the correct answer.
ex.zh: 在正确答案旁边打上对勾。

ex.en: She ticked off each item as it was unloaded from the truck.
ex.zh: 每卸下一件物品，她都逐一打钩核对。

ex.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit here are likely to be given a ticket.
ex.zh: 在此路段超速的司机很可能收到罚单。

ex.en: A feather drifted down and tickled her nose, making her sneeze.
ex.zh: 一根羽毛飘落下来，挠得她鼻子发痒，让她打了个喷嚏。

tide.usage: swim with the tide 随波逐流,随大流;go against the tide 反潮流；索引p418

ex.en: The tide comes in twice a day along this coast.
ex.zh: 这段海岸每天涨潮两次。

ex.en: The government is struggling to turn the tide of rising unemployment.
ex.zh: 政府正努力扭转失业率上升的趋势。

ex.en: Fishermen time their trips according to the tides.
ex.zh: 渔民根据潮汐安排出海时间。

senses: adj. 整洁的,整齐的,有条理的,工整的
tidy.usage: 记：他是个爱整洁的人，每天都收拾房间。

ex.en: A tidy desk, psychologists note, can help people concentrate on their work.
ex.zh: 心理学家指出，整洁的书桌有助于人们专注工作。

senses: n. 联系,关系,纽带(c);束缚,约束

ex.en: The two universities have close academic ties dating back several decades.
ex.zh: 这两所大学有着数十年之久的密切学术联系。

ex.en: Conservationists warn that the wild tiger population is still declining sharply.
ex.zh: 自然保护人士警告，野生老虎数量仍在急剧下降。

senses: adj. 紧的,紧身的,装紧的

phrases.p: keep a tight hold on the purse

tight.usage: 记：他最近手头很拮据，要对各项开支进行严格的控制。

ex.en: Many graduates face a tight job market and heavy student debts.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生面临紧张的就业市场和沉重的学生债务。

ex.en: The central bank tightened lending rules to reduce financial risks.
ex.zh: 中央银行收紧了信贷规则以降低金融风险。

ex.en: The bathroom floor is covered with blue ceramic tiles.
ex.zh: 浴室地面铺着蓝色瓷砖。

ex.en: Workers are replacing the broken tiles on the church roof.
ex.zh: 工人们正在更换教堂屋顶上破损的瓦片。

ex.en: They tiled the kitchen walls themselves to save money.
ex.zh: 为了省钱，他们自己给厨房墙面贴了瓷砖。

ex.en: The library stays open till midnight during the exam season.
ex.zh: 考试季图书馆一直开放到午夜。

ex.en: The new tax policy tilts the playing field in favour of large corporations.
ex.zh: 新税收政策使竞争环境向大公司倾斜。

ex.en: The house was built of local timber a century ago.
ex.zh: 这座房子一个世纪前用当地木材建成。

ex.en: Falling timber prices have hurt the region's logging industry.
ex.zh: 木材价格下跌使该地区的伐木业受到打击。

ex.en: Much of the timber exported last year came from sustainable forests.
ex.zh: 去年出口的木材大多来自可持续经营的森林。

senses: n. 时机,机会;时期,时势
v. 测定...时间;为...定时;调整,调准
time.usage: at no time从不;at one time曾经,一度;at times有时;in no time立即;take one's time从容;谚语:Time and tide wait for no man岁月不饶人

ex.en: Companies that adapted in time survived the economic downturn.
ex.zh: 及时调整的公司挺过了经济低迷期。

senses: adj. 不受时间影响的,永不过时的;永存的,永恒的,永久的

ex.en: Shakespeare's plays remain timeless because they explore universal human emotions.
ex.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧经久不衰，因为它们探讨了人类普遍的情感。

senses: n. [C] (做某事所需要的)时间，时段
n. (事情发生或完成所需要的)一段时间,期限
n. (事情发生或完成所需要的)时间

ex.en: The new train timetable cuts journey times between the two cities by half an hour.
ex.zh: 新的列车时刻表把两座城市之间的行程时间缩短了半小时。

ex.en: Timid children need careful handling to build up their confidence.
ex.zh: 胆小的孩子需要细心的对待来建立他们的信心。

ex.en: His timidity in negotiations cost the firm several valuable contracts.
ex.zh: 他在谈判中的怯懦使公司失去了几份颇有价值的合同。

tin.usage: 派生tinny不结实的;发出薄的金属声的

ex.en: The kitchen cupboard was filled with tins of soup and beans.
ex.zh: 厨房橱柜里装满了罐装汤和豆子罐头。

tiny.usage: 记：老鼠对象来说是极小的，但对蚊子来说是巨大的。；adj.极小的，微小的

senses: 表行为的过程或结果，名词词性

ex.en: The construction of the new bridge is expected to take roughly two years.
ex.zh: 新桥的修建预计将耗时约两年。

senses: n. [C] 实用的提示；小费；尖端
tip.usage: 作"小费"讲时可数。近义：hint n. 提示；建议

ex.en: The guidebook offers useful tips for travellers on a limited budget.
ex.zh: 这本旅行指南为预算有限的游客提供了实用建议。

tire.usage: 又:a spare tire备用轮胎;派生tireless精力充沛的

ex.en: Long meetings tire even the most enthusiastic employees.
ex.zh: 冗长的会议连最有热情的员工也会感到疲倦。

senses: a. 疲倦的；厌倦；陈腐的；陈词滥调的

ex.en: Local officials say they are tired of empty promises and want concrete action.
ex.zh: 当地官员表示，他们厌倦了空洞的承诺，希望看到切实行动。

senses: adj. 使人厌倦的,讨厌的

ex.en: Filling in the same forms every month is a tiresome but necessary task.
ex.zh: 每月填写相同的表格虽是件烦人的差事，却必不可少。

senses: n. (人或动物细胞的)组织；纸巾
tissue.usage: 掏出口袋里的餐巾纸看一下上面有英文单词tissue；索引p418

ex.en: Dyes were extracted by boiling the plant tissue.
ex.zh: 用煮的方法从植物组织中提取染料。

ex.en: He wiped his tears with a paper tissue.
ex.zh: 他用纸巾擦去眼泪。

ex.en: The microscope revealed abnormal cells in the brain tissue.
ex.zh: 显微镜显示脑组织中有异常细胞。

senses: adj. 极强大的;极重要的;巨大的

ex.en: The two firms made a titanic effort to complete the merger before the regulatory deadline.
ex.zh: 两家公司竭尽全力，赶在监管最后期限之前完成了合并。

title.usage: n.名称，标题；头衔；职称； 称号 v.加标题，定题目

senses: prep. 向，朝，往，对着（某方向或某处）；到

ex.en: Companies have yet to agree on a common standard for data sharing.
ex.zh: 各公司尚未就数据共享的通用标准达成一致。

senses: n. 吐司，烤面包片；祝酒，敬酒
toast.usage: 同义 drink to；派生 toaster n. (电的)面包片加热器

tobacco.usage: 【记】烟草植株是制造烟草制品的原材料。

ex.en: The government has raised taxes on tobacco to discourage young people from smoking.
ex.zh: 政府提高了烟草税，以劝阻年轻人吸烟。

ex.en: Today, artificial intelligence plays a growing role in medical diagnosis.
ex.zh: 如今，人工智能在医学诊断中发挥着越来越大的作用。

senses: n. (学步期或刚学会走路的)幼童

ex.en: Parents of toddlers are advised to keep small objects out of children's reach.
ex.zh: 建议幼儿家长把小物件放在孩子够不到的地方。

senses: n. 脚趾；（鞋、袜的）足尖部

ex.en: He stepped on my toe in the crowded bus and apologised at once.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的公交车上他踩到了我的脚趾，并立刻道了歉。

senses: ad. 在一起；共同；以使接触（或相结合）；同时

ex.en: The two laboratories worked together to develop the new vaccine.
ex.zh: 两个实验室合作研发了这种新疫苗。

senses: v. (长时间)苦干,辛勤劳作;艰难缓慢地移动跋涉
toil.usage: 近义：labor vi. 劳作；索引p418

ex.en: The station's public toilets were renovated last year after repeated complaints.
ex.zh: 在多次收到投诉后，车站的公共厕所去年进行了翻新。

senses: a. 象征性的；装点门面的
n. ①表示，标志，象征，证明，信物
②纪念品；③礼券，代价券，筹码，专用辅币

phrases.m: 由于同样原因，同样地；而且，再说

token.usage: 记：这张代金券是他让我给你的，说是一点小小的表示。；同义 symbol, sign, proof, keepsake；辨析：sign 表标志指示；symbol 指情况或状态的象征；in token of 表达某些情感或敬意；n.代币；象征，标志；代金券 adj.象征性的

ex.en: The school operates a zero-tolerance policy towards bullying of any kind.
ex.zh: 该校对任何形式的欺凌行为都实行零容忍政策。

tolerance.usage: 反义 intolerance n. 不宽容，无法忍受；偏执；n.忍受，容忍；忍耐力；索引p418

ex.en: She had no tolerance for jokes of any kind.
ex.zh: 她容不得开任何玩笑。

ex.en: A healthy democracy depends on tolerance of opinions that the majority finds unpleasant.
ex.zh: 健康的民主取决于对多数人反感的观点的容忍。

ex.en: Regular drinking raises your tolerance for alcohol, so you need more to feel the same effect.
ex.zh: 经常饮酒会提高对酒精的耐受性，因此需要喝得更多才能产生同样的效果。

tolerant.usage: 派生 tolerantly adv. 容忍地；adj.宽容的，容忍的；能耐… 的；索引p418

ex.en: Societies tend to become more tolerant of difference as people meet other cultures through travel and trade.
ex.zh: 随着人们通过旅行和贸易接触其他文化，社会往往会变得更宽容。

ex.en: The new strain of wheat is tolerant of drought and grows well in dry regions.
ex.zh: 这种小麦新品种耐旱，在干旱地区长势良好。

ex.en: Older employees are not always tolerant of the informal habits of younger colleagues.
ex.zh: 年长员工并不总能容忍年轻同事不拘礼节的习惯。

senses: v. 允许，容许；忍受，容忍
tolerate.usage: 辨析：tolerate 指对人或行为的容忍，不指苦难；bear(stand) 指对苦难、疼痛等的忍受，多用于否定句；endure 更正式，多用于否定句；派生 tolerable 可忍受的；tole（发音类似逃了）+rate（速度）→他以很快的速度逃跑了，因为忍受到了极点→忍受，容忍；tole（发音类似逃了）+rate（

ex.en: I don't know how you tolerate that noise!
ex.zh: 我不知道你怎么能忍受那样的噪声！

ex.en: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
ex.zh: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安保程序以增加安全保障。

ex.en: The regulator warned that it would not tolerate misleading claims in insurance advertising.
ex.zh: 监管机构警告说，它绝不会容忍保险广告中的误导性宣传。

senses: n. 通行税(费);代价;损失
v. 鸣钟(特指宣布死亡)

ex.en: The earthquake took a heavy toll on the region's infrastructure.
ex.zh: 地震对该地区的基础设施造成了严重破坏。

ex.en: Consumers can call the company's toll-free number to report faulty products.
ex.zh: 消费者可拨打该公司的免费电话报告产品故障。

ex.en: Scientists have bred a new tomato that stays fresh for weeks.
ex.zh: 科学家培育出一种能保鲜数周的新品种番茄。

tomb.usage: 助记:恐怖分子bomb(轰炸)了tomb(坟墓)

ex.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient tomb filled with bronze objects.
ex.zh: 考古学家发现了一座满是青铜器物的古墓。

ex.en: The final decision on the project will be announced tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 项目的最终决定将于明天上午公布。

ex.en: The steel plant produces several tons of metal every day.
ex.zh: 这家钢铁厂每天生产数吨钢材。

senses: n. [sing.,U]（作品、演讲、活动等的）基调，格调
n. 音调,音色;风气,气氛
tone.usage: 记：ton(音)+e→说话的声音和口气→语气；[族]tonal a.音调的；toneless a.缺乏声调的

ex.en: talk in an even tone
ex.zh: 用平和的语气说话

tongue.usage: 又:have lost one's tongue吓得说不出话;shoe tongue鞋舌

ex.en: Most children acquire their mother tongue simply by listening to those around them.
ex.zh: 大多数儿童仅凭倾听周围的人就习得了母语。

ex.en: Meteorologists warn that temperatures will fall sharply tonight.
ex.zh: 气象学家警告今夜气温将骤降。

senses: ad. 太，过于，过度；也；又；还；很；非常

ex.en: The report came too late to influence the outcome of the election.
ex.zh: 这份报告来得太晚，未能影响选举结果。

tool.usage: 辨析:tool指手工工具或解决问题的手段;instrument指仪器,用于科研及精细工作

ex.en: Data analysis has become an essential tool for modern journalists.
ex.zh: 数据分析已成为现代记者的必备工具。

senses: n. 牙，牙齿；（梳子、锯子等的）齿

ex.en: Sugary drinks are a major cause of tooth decay among children.
ex.zh: 含糖饮料是儿童龋齿的主要原因。

senses: a. 无齿的；没有权威的；不起作用的
adj. 无牙齿的；没有权威的

ex.en: Without enforcement powers, the new consumer watchdog will be toothless.
ex.zh: 若没有执法权，新设的消费者监督机构将形同虚设。

senses: vt. 高过,超过,到达……的顶部
n. 顶(部),上边,上面;首位,最高位

phrases.m: 幸福到极点,对一切都感到满意

top.usage: 又:on top of在……之上;辨析:at the top of在顶端,喻最高地位

ex.en: The company rose to the top of the industry within a decade.
ex.zh: 这家公司在十年内登上了行业顶端。

senses: a. 从总体到具体的；先总后分的；与高层有关的

ex.en: Critics argue that top-down management stifles creativity among junior staff.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，自上而下的管理压制了基层员工的创造力。

ex.en: Climate change has become the central topic of international economic forums.
ex.zh: 气候变化已成为国际经济论坛的核心议题。

ex.en: The power cut left us searching for a torch in the dark.
ex.zh: 停电后我们在黑暗中摸索着手电筒。

senses: vt. 折磨,欺负,虐待,使苦恼
n. （尤指精神上的）折磨，痛苦；苦难之源
v. 使备受折磨；使痛苦；烦扰
torment.usage: tor（=tort“扭曲”）+ment（后缀）→扭曲的状态→折磨，痛苦。

ex.en: She suffered years of mental torment after her son's death.
ex.zh: 儿子去世后，她多年悲痛欲绝。

ex.en: The tornado ripped through the small town, leaving hundreds of homes destroyed.
ex.zh: 龙卷风席卷了这座小镇，数百所房屋被毁。

ex.en: Heavy rain sent a torrent of water down the mountain valley.
ex.zh: 暴雨使湍急的洪水沿山谷奔泻而下。

senses: n. 侵权行为(不构成刑事犯罪但可引起民事诉讼)

ex.en: In tort cases, courts may award damages even where no contract exists.
ex.zh: 在侵权案件中，即使不存在合同，法院也可能判给赔偿金。

senses: vt./n. 歪曲,扭曲;拷问;折磨
v. 拷打，拷问，严刑逼供；使痛苦
torture.usage: 同义:distress,torment,agonize；n./v.拷打，拷问；折磨，煎熬；adj.遭受重创的

ex.en: Many of the rebels were captured and tortured by secret police.
ex.zh: 反叛者中许多人被捕并遭受到秘密警察的酷刑。

ex.en: The prisoners were subjected to mental as well as physical torture.
ex.zh: 囚犯们不仅遭受肉体折磨，还遭受精神折磨。

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was sheer torture for the whole family.
ex.zh: 等待检查结果对全家人来说都是一种折磨。

ex.en: Passengers were tossed from side to side as the ship rocked in the storm.
ex.zh: 船在风暴中摇晃，乘客们被颠得东倒西歪。

senses: adj. 总的，全部的，完全的
adj. 总的，总计的，全部的；完全的；彻底的
total.usage: 发音类似"通通"→通通都是→全部的，完全的

ex.en: All the people we interviewed expressed almost total satisfaction with it.
ex.zh: 我们采访的所有人都对此都表示几乎完全满意。

senses: vt. 感动；触摸；碰；移动；碰到
n. ①触动，碰到，触摸(c/u) ②少许，一点儿
touch.usage: 另 touch on 关系到，涉及；touch up 润色，改进

ex.en: Even a small act of kindness can touch a stranger's heart.
ex.zh: 即使是一个微小的善举也能打动陌生人的心。

senses: ③强硬的，顽固的 ④艰苦的，棘手的；粗暴的

phrases.p: take a tough line on sth.

tough.usage: 【记】越是棘手的工作越能塑造出坚强的品格。；反义 weak adj. 虚弱的；adj.坚强的，艰难的，严厉的， 强硬的 n.恶棍 v.坚持，忍耐；发音很像“它服”。“坚强的”人敢于拼搏，战胜困难，让它服从于自己。

ex.en: Sometimes it is easy to feel bad because you are going through tough times.
ex.zh: 有时候，我们很容易因为正在经历艰难的时期而感到难过。

ex.en: The government is taking a tough line on drunk driving.
ex.zh: 政府对酒后驾车采取强硬态度。

ex.en: It was a tough decision, but she knew she could not stay.
ex.zh: 这是个艰难的决定，但她知道自己不能留下。

ex.en: The recruits' toughness impressed the coach even more than their raw talent.
ex.zh: 新队员的坚韧给教练留下的印象甚至超过了他们的天赋。

ex.en: The band is preparing for a nationwide tour to promote its new album.
ex.zh: 乐队正准备全国巡演以宣传新专辑。

ex.en: The island's economy depends heavily on tourism, which employs one in three workers.
ex.zh: 该岛经济严重依赖旅游业，三分之一的从业者从事这一行业。

ex.en: The ancient town attracts millions of tourists from home and abroad every year.
ex.zh: 这座古镇每年吸引数百万海内外游客。

ex.en: Cars parked illegally on the motorway will be towed away at the owner's expense.
ex.zh: 违法停在高速公路上的车辆将被拖走，费用由车主承担。

senses: ②(表示关系)对于；③(表示时间)将近

ex.en: Public attitudes towards genetically modified food have gradually softened.
ex.zh: 公众对转基因食品的态度已逐渐缓和。

ex.en: Hotels are encouraged to let guests reuse towels to reduce water consumption.
ex.zh: 酒店被鼓励让客人重复使用毛巾以减少用水。

ex.en: The control tower guides aircraft safely through the fog.
ex.zh: 塔台引导飞机在浓雾中安全飞行。

senses: n. 镇；市镇；商业区；居民

ex.en: The small coastal town depends almost entirely on tourism for its income.
ex.zh: 这座海滨小镇的收入几乎完全依赖旅游业。

ex.en: The townsfolk gathered in the square to celebrate the opening of the annual festival.
ex.zh: 镇上居民聚集在广场上，庆祝一年一度节日的开幕。

toxic.usage: 派生toxicity毒性,毒力;助记:tox(毒)+ic(形容词后缀)→有毒的

ex.en: The factory was heavily fined for dumping toxic waste into the river.
ex.zh: 这家工厂因向河中倾倒有毒废料而被重罚。

ex.en: Child psychologists stress that simple toys often stimulate more creativity than electronic gadgets.
ex.zh: 儿童心理学家强调，简单的玩具往往比电子产品更能激发创造力。

ex.en: The new policy is designed to attract skilled workers from overseas.
ex.zh: 新政策旨在吸引海外技术工人。

ex.en: The treaty was signed to reduce trade barriers between the two nations.
ex.zh: 两国签署了该条约，以减少彼此间的贸易壁垒。

senses: ②微量，少许；v. ①追踪，跟踪
vt. 追溯；勾画出(轮廓)，描绘
trace.usage: t（字母发音类似“踢”）+race（比赛）→踢（足球）比赛，大家都是你追我赶，在互相追逐→追踪；痕迹；索引p418

ex.en: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning, growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
ex.zh: 文学史专业的学生对于接下来25年间伊丽莎白戏剧的发展格外感兴趣，因为在这段短暂的时期内，我们可以了解很多戏剧种类和伟大职业的起源、发展、兴盛和衰退。

ex.en: Language probably traces back at least 80,000 years.
ex.zh: 语言的出现至少可以追溯到8万年前。

ex.en: In Oliver Twist, he traces an orphan's progress from the workhouse to the criminal slums of London.
ex.zh: 在《雾都孤儿》中，他描绘了一个孤儿从救济院到伦敦犯罪贫民窟的历程。

senses: adj. 可追溯的;可追踪的;可追本溯源的
adj. 可追踪的；可追本溯源的
traceable.usage: adj.可追踪的；可追溯的；索引p418

senses: ②小道，小径；v. 跟踪，追踪

phrases.m: 跟上……进展，保持与……的联系
不能跟上……的进展，失去与……的联系

track.usage: n.小径，踪迹；轨道；田径 v.跟踪；n.小道，小径；踪迹；轨道 v.追查，追踪；索引p418

ex.en: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioral ads? Or should they have explicit permission?
ex.zh: 广告商是否可以认为用户愿意被追踪并接收行为广告？还是说广告商应该先得到用户的明确许可？

ex.en: The satellites track the movement of migrating birds across continents.
ex.zh: 卫星追踪候鸟跨大陆的迁徙活动。

ex.en: The police followed the tracks left by the thief in the snow.
ex.zh: 警方顺着小偷在雪地上留下的足迹追踪。

senses: n. [U] (录像机的)图像跟踪(系统)

ex.en: The delivery app offers real-time tracking so customers know when their parcels will arrive.
ex.zh: 这款快递应用提供实时跟踪，顾客可以知道包裹何时送达。

ex.en: The charity's moving stories attracted donations from all over the country.
ex.zh: 慈善机构感人的故事吸引了来自全国各地的捐款。

tractor.usage: n.拖拉机；tract（拖，拉）+or（名词词缀）→能拖拉东西的车→拖拉机。

ex.en: What's needed to build a complex airliner or a tractor?
ex.zh: 建造一架复杂的客机或拖拉机需要什么？

ex.en: The farmer bought a new tractor to replace his old one.
ex.zh: 农夫买了一台新拖拉机来替换旧的。

ex.en: Modern tractors are equipped with GPS to guide planting with great precision.
ex.zh: 现代拖拉机装有GPS，能够非常精准地引导播种。

senses: v. 从事贸易;进行交换
trade.usage: trade in...with与...进行某方面的贸易;派生trader生意人；n.贸易；行业 v.做买卖；交易，交换；索引p418

ex.en: The two countries signed an agreement to expand bilateral trade.
ex.zh: 两国签署了扩大双边贸易的协议。

ex.en: He learned the trade of carpentry from his father.
ex.zh: 他跟父亲学的是木工手艺。

ex.en: Digital technology has transformed the way companies trade across borders.
ex.zh: 数字技术改变了企业跨国交易的方式。

ex.en: The trade fair gave small manufacturers a rare chance to meet overseas buyers face to face.
ex.zh: 这次交易会让小型制造商获得了与海外买家当面接洽的难得机会。

ex.en: Registering a trademark protects a brand from being copied by rivals.
ex.zh: 注册商标可以保护品牌不被竞争对手仿冒。

senses: n. 传统的信仰（或风俗）

phrases.p: achieve a balance between tradition and reality
phrases.m: 在传统和现实之间取得平衡

ex.en: It is a family tradition to gather for dinner on New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 除夕夜全家聚餐是这家的传统。

ex.en: By tradition, the youngest member opens the festival celebrations.
ex.zh: 按照惯例，由最年轻的成员宣布节庆活动开始。

ex.en: The tribe has managed to preserve its cultural tradition despite outside pressure.
ex.zh: 尽管面临外部压力，这个部落仍设法保存了自己的文化传统。

ex.en: The only previous study analyzing causality, based on an area in Mexico that had instituted CCTs, supported the traditional view.
ex.zh: 只有一项此前的研究对墨西哥某个实施有条件现金转移支付（CCT）项目的地区进行了因果关系分析，印证了上述传统的观点。

ex.en: Traditionally, families gather for a large meal on the eve of the Spring Festival.
ex.zh: 按照传统，家家户户在除夕夜团聚吃团圆饭。

ex.en: City planners are expanding cycle lanes to ease traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 城市规划者正在扩建自行车道以缓解交通拥堵。

ex.en: The tragedy prompted an official investigation into safety standards at the mine.
ex.zh: 这场悲剧促使官方对矿场的安全标准展开调查。

senses: n. 悲惨的事,惨案,灾难,不幸
tragedy.usage: 有些人的人生像喜剧(comedy)，有些人的人生像悲剧(tragedy)

ex.en: Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
ex.zh: 欧洲正见证着宗教剧的消亡，以及在古典悲剧和喜剧启发之下新型戏剧形式的诞生。

senses: adj. 悲剧的,悲惨的,悲哀的

ex.en: The bridge collapse was a tragic accident that could have been prevented.
ex.zh: 桥梁坍塌是一起本可避免的悲惨事故。

ex.en: It is tragic that so much talent is wasted because of a lack of opportunity.
ex.zh: 如此多的才华因缺乏机会而被浪费，实在令人悲哀。

ex.en: The play ends with the tragic death of its honest hero.
ex.zh: 该剧以正直主人公的悲惨死亡结尾。

ex.en: Years of training prepared the young pilot for the emergency landing.
ex.zh: 多年的训练让这位年轻飞行员为紧急着陆做好了准备。

senses: n. 踪迹,痕迹;(乡间)小道
trail.usage: 记：tra(拉)+il→马拉车留下的印迹→痕迹；[近]track n.踪迹；trace vt.追踪；rail联想成railway（铁路），t联想成“他”，那就是他沿着铁路走，留下了很长的一串脚印，也就是“踪迹，痕迹”

ex.en: trails of dead volcanoes
ex.zh: 死火山的痕迹

ex.en: The police are still on the trail of the escaped prisoner.
ex.zh: 警方仍在追捕逃犯。

senses: n. 列车,火车;行列,一串

ex.en: It takes nearly a decade to train a fully qualified surgeon.
ex.zh: 培养一名完全合格的外科医生需要近十年时间。

ex.en: Each trainee is assigned an experienced mentor during the first three months.
ex.zh: 每位实习生在头三个月都会被指派一名经验丰富的导师。

ex.en: New employees receive several weeks of training before they start work.
ex.zh: 新员工在正式上岗前要接受数周的培训。

trait.usage: n.特征，特点；发音类似“踹他”→他的“特点”就是什么事情都想用暴力来解决，这是不对的→特点，特性。；索引p418

ex.en: Awareness of class is a typically British trait.
ex.zh: 阶层意识是英国人的典型特征。

ex.en: sociable traits // linguistic traits
ex.zh: 社交特点 // 语言特征

ex.en: Curiosity is the trait that most reliably distinguishes successful scientists from their less productive peers.
ex.zh: 好奇心是区分成功科学家与其较平庸同行最可靠的特征。

senses: n. 叛徒；背信弃义的人
traitor.usage: 发音类似“捶（打）他”→出卖公司机密的“叛徒”，同事们想捶（打）他

ex.en: In the novel, the general is branded a traitor for selling secrets to the enemy.
ex.zh: 在小说中，这位将军因向敌人出卖机密而被斥为叛徒。

senses: n. (射体在空中的)轨道;弹道;轨迹

ex.en: The spacecraft fired its engines briefly to correct its trajectory before entering orbit.
ex.zh: 航天器在进入轨道前短暂点火，以修正其飞行轨迹。

ex.en: Visitors can reach the museum by tram from the city centre.
ex.zh: 游客可从市中心乘有轨电车到达博物馆。

senses: n. 流浪汉;荡妇;远行;沉重的脚步声
v. 拖着沉重的步子走;踩;踏

ex.en: We tramped through the deep snow for hours before finally reaching the cabin.
ex.zh: 我们在深雪中跋涉了好几个小时，才终于抵达小屋。

ex.en: Passengers can transfer to the airport line at the next station.
ex.zh: 乘客可在下一站换乘机场线。

ex.en: An increasing share of business is now transacted online rather than in person.
ex.zh: 如今越来越多的业务是在网上而非当面完成的。

senses: n. ①办理，处理，交易，事务(c)
n. 交易，业务；办理，处理
transaction.usage: [族] transact v. 做交易；[族] transact vt. 办理；处理；n.交易，买卖，业务；n.交易，业务；办理；trans（变换）+action（行动，活动）→交换行动→交易；词根记忆：trans(change,交换)+act(do,行动)+ion(名词后缀)→交换的行动→交易；索引p418

ex.en: Using the Internet can significantly reduce transaction costs.
ex.zh: 因特网的使用可以大大减少交易成本。

ex.en: Mr. Schmidt described it as a "voluntary ecosystem" in which "individuals and organisations can complete online transactions with confidence, trusting the identities of each other and the identities of the infrastructure on which the transaction runs."
ex.zh: 施密特先生把它描述为一种"自愿型生态系统"，在这个生态系统中，"个人和组织可以放心地完成网上交易，信任彼此的身份以及交易得以进行的网络基础设施的身份"。

ex.en: Every online transaction leaves a digital record that companies can analyse for commercial purposes.
ex.zh: 每一笔在线交易都会留下数字记录，公司可以出于商业目的对其进行分析。

phrases.m: 优于或胜过某人(某事物)

transcend.usage: v.超出，超越；tran（横过，越过）+scend（爬，攀）→爬越障碍→超越；索引p418

ex.en: His works by far transcend anything that has gone before.
ex.zh: 他的作品远远超越了以往的任何作品。

ex.en: The appeal of her music transcends age and nationality, drawing listeners from every generation.
ex.zh: 她的音乐魅力超越年龄和国界，吸引着一代又一代听众。

ex.en: Climate change is a problem that transcends national borders, so no country can solve it alone.
ex.zh: 气候变化是一个超越国界的问题，任何国家都无法单独解决。

ex.en: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
ex.zh: 正是这种显而易见的政治超越解释了君主作为国家元首将继续受欢迎的原因。

ex.en: The pianist gave a transcendent performance that audiences would remember for years.
ex.zh: 这位钢琴家的演奏超凡出众，令观众多年难忘。

transcendental.usage: adj.卓越的，超越的；超自然的

ex.en: The philosopher rejected purely transcendental explanations and insisted on observable evidence.
ex.zh: 这位哲学家拒绝纯先验的解释，坚持以可观察的证据为依据。

ex.en: Emerson, a leading transcendentalist, argued that individuals should trust their own intuition.
ex.zh: 爱默生是先验论的领军人物，他主张个人应相信自己的直觉。

senses: v. 记录;改写成;转录;抄写;用音标标音;改编(乐曲)

ex.en: The interview was transcribed and carefully checked for accuracy before publication.
ex.zh: 访谈内容经转录并仔细核对无误后才发表。

senses: v. （使）转移，搬迁；（使）调动；转职；转学；改变（环境）
transfer.usage: v.转移；转让 n.转移，转让，调动；trans（移动）+fer（拿）→从一个地方移动或拿到另一个地方→转移；搬迁。；索引p418

ex.en: He announced that the company had been transferred to another city.
ex.zh: 他宣布公司已搬到另一座城市。

ex.en: She asked for a transfer to the Paris office to be closer to her elderly parents.
ex.zh: 她申请调到巴黎办事处，以便离年迈的父母更近一些。

ex.en: The technology was developed for medicine and later transferred to the car industry.
ex.zh: 这项技术最初为医学而开发，后来被转移到汽车工业。

ex.en: The transferability of skills between industries is a key concern for many job seekers.
ex.zh: 技能在行业间的可转移性是许多求职者关注的关键问题。

senses: a. 可转移的；可转让的
adj. 可转移的；可调动的；可转让的

ex.en: Internships offer transferable skills that graduates can apply across industries.
ex.zh: 实习提供的可迁移技能让毕业生能应用于各个行业。

senses: v. 改变，改造，变换，使改观
v. 使改变形态；使改观；改变
transform.usage: trans-（转）+form（形式）→转换形式→转变。近义：convert v. （使）转变；convert 的近义词；transform 指彻底改变性质、性格；change 强调本质改变；alter 指局部改变后基本保持原状；vary 强调无规则、陆续的变化；v.转换，改变，改造；trans（转变）+form（形式）

ex.en: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
ex.zh: 但是将发现的声明变为一个成熟的发现是需要集体的审查和集体的接受。

ex.en: Cheap solar panels have transformed energy supply in villages the national grid never reached.
ex.zh: 廉价的太阳能板改变了国家电网从未覆盖的村庄的能源供应。

ex.en: Digital publishing has transformed how readers discover, buy and share books.
ex.zh: 数字出版改变了读者发现、购买和分享图书的方式。

senses: adj. 有改革能力的，起改造作用的

ex.en: The internet has had a transformative effect on how ordinary people access information.
ex.zh: 互联网对普通人获取信息的方式产生了变革性的影响。

ex.en: A faulty transformer cut off electricity to thousands of households overnight.
ex.zh: 一台出故障的变压器一夜之间导致数千户家庭断电。

senses: adj. ①短暂的，转瞬即逝的
transient.usage: adj.短暂的；临时的 n.暂住者；索引p418

ex.en: The town's prosperity proved transient once the mine closed.
ex.zh: 矿山一关闭，这座小镇的繁荣就被证明是短暂的。

ex.en: Her feeling of disappointment was transient and soon gave way to hope.
ex.zh: 她的失望情绪转瞬即逝，很快便让位于希望。

ex.en: The homeless shelter provides beds for a transient population of workers.
ex.zh: 这家收容所为流动务工人员提供床位。

senses: n. 晶体管，晶体管收音机

ex.en: The invention of the transistor revolutionised the entire electronics industry.
ex.zh: 晶体管的发明给整个电子工业带来了革命性变化。

senses: n. 运输，运送，搬动，载运(u)
n. 通过；经过；通行；过境；中转(u)

ex.en: The city is investing heavily in public transit to reduce car use.
ex.zh: 该市正大力投资公共交通以减少汽车使用。

senses: n. 过渡，转变，变革，变迁(c/u)

phrases.p: a transition from A to B
phrases.m: 从 A 到 B 的过渡

transition.usage: [族] transitional a. 过渡性的；索引p418

phrases.p: translate into a lack of sales

translate.usage: 【记】翻译（translation）是把一种语言形式转变（translate）为另外一种语言形式的过程。；扩：translator n. 翻译家；近：convert vt.&vi. (使)转变；trans（变换）+lat（拿出，放）+e→在不同的语言间变换→翻译，转变

ex.en: I hope all the hard work will translate into profits.
ex.zh: 我希望所有的辛勤劳动都会有回报。

phrases.p: the translation of theory into practice

translation.usage: 记：翻译家(translator)林纾完成的《巴黎茶花女遗事》译本(translation)蜚声中外文坛。

ex.en: A good translation should preserve both the meaning and the style of the original.
ex.zh: 好的译本应同时保留原文的意义与风格。

ex.en: Scientists studied whether the disease was transmissible from animals to humans.
ex.zh: 科学家研究了这种疾病是否能在动物与人类之间传播。

senses: n. 播送,发射,传送,传染,传播

transmit.usage: 族：transmission n. 传送；传播。近义：convey vt. 传送，传达；同义: convey, carry; send; transfer；trans（穿过，通过）+m（联想成“门”）+it（它）→让它从门里穿过去，发送出去→传送；词根:trans(across穿过)+mit(send放出)→信号从此穿

ex.en: Movies can be transmitted over the Internet.
ex.zh: 电影可以通过因特网传送。

ex.en: Men make their own history, but they do not make it just as they please; they do not make it under circumstances chosen by themselves, but under circumstances directly found, given and transmitted from the past.
ex.zh: 人类创造自己的历史，并不是按照自己喜欢的那样创造的；创造历史也并不是在人类自己选择的环境下，而是在直接碰到的、既定的、从过去传下来的环境下。

ex.en: The disease is transmitted through close contact with infected animals.
ex.zh: 这种疾病通过与受感染动物的密切接触传播。

ex.en: Investors are demanding greater transparency in how companies report their earnings.
ex.zh: 投资者要求公司在业绩报告方面提高透明度。

senses: adj. 易识破的，显而易见的
transparent.usage: [族] transparency n. 透明；透明度；索引p418

ex.en: Decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
ex.zh: 人工智能系统做出的决定应该是可以解释的、透明的并且合理的。

senses: v. 移植(器官等);移种(植物等)

phrases.p: transplant nine teeth into one's jaw
phrases.m: 往某人的颌内移植九颗牙齿

transplant.usage: trans-（转移）+plant（种植）→把树转移到别的地方种植→移种；trans(转移)+plant(种植)→转移种植→移植；同义: transfer; move, migrate；v.移植；迁移；移栽 n.移植；移植的器官；trans（变换）+plant（种植）→变换种植，从这儿种到那儿→移植；索引p418

ex.en: Across the Atlantic came successive groups of Englishmen, Frenchmen, Germans, Scots, Irishmen, Dutchmen, Swedes, and many others who attempted to transplant their habits and traditions to the new world.
ex.zh: 成群的英格兰人、法国人、德国人、苏格兰人、爱尔兰人、荷兰人、瑞典人和许多其他民族的人接连不断地跨越大西洋来到这里，试图将他们的习惯和传统移植到新世界。

ex.en: Doctors performed the hospital's first heart transplant last year, and the patient has recovered well.
ex.zh: 医生们去年完成了该医院的首例心脏移植手术，病人恢复良好。

ex.en: Advances in organ transplantation have saved tens of thousands of lives over recent decades.
ex.zh: 近几十年来，器官移植技术的进步挽救了数万人的生命。

senses: n. 运输,运送;运输系统,运载工具
n. 交通运输系统；运输工具
vt. 使产生身临其境的感觉；运输；传播
transport.usage: [记] trans-（转移）+ port（港口）→将货物从一个港口转移到另一个港口→运输；辨析: transport 做交通讲实指运输工具; traffic 指街上行人车马的数量,交通拥挤/中断用 traffic；n.运输；交通工具；交通运输 系统 v.运输，运送；trans（变换）+port（港口）→从一个港口换到另

ex.en: Surely small towns and big cities both have some problems in terms of transport.
ex.zh: 当然，小城镇和大城市在交通方面都有一些问题。

ex.en: Improving public transport is cheaper than building new roads and reduces congestion at the same time.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通比修建新道路更省钱，同时还能减少拥堵。

ex.en: The city plans to invest heavily in electric buses to cut pollution from public transport.
ex.zh: 该市计划大力投资电动巴士，以减少公共交通造成的污染。

transverse.usage: [记] trans-（横过）+vers（转）+e →横着转过去→横向的

ex.en: Engineers installed transverse beams to strengthen the ageing bridge deck.
ex.zh: 工程师安装了横向横梁，以加固老化的桥面。

senses: v. 使落入险境，使陷入困境
n. （捕捉动物的）陷阱；圈套；诡计；困境
trap.usage: 助记:tray(盘子)掉入trap(陷阱)里；去山区旅行(trip)结果被大雪困在(trap)了山里

ex.en: She had set a trap for him and he had walked straight into it.
ex.zh: 她给他设下圈套，他就径直钻了进去。

senses: n. [C] 捕杀动物者(尤指为获取毛皮)

ex.en: In the nineteenth century, the trapper sold beaver furs to merchants from the east.
ex.zh: 十九世纪，这位捕兽人把河狸毛皮卖给来自东部的商人。

senses: n. [U] 垃圾；拙劣的作品；废物
n. 拙劣的材料,作品等

ex.en: The city plans to turn household trash into electricity and fertilizer.
ex.zh: 该市计划将生活垃圾转化为电力和肥料。

senses: n. 艰苦劳动;艰辛,煎熬

ex.en: After years of economic travail, the region finally began to attract new investment.
ex.zh: 经历多年的经济煎熬之后，该地区终于开始吸引新的投资。

travel.usage: 辨析:travel是旅行的统称,不可数,前不加冠词;journey指陆地上的旅行;trip指短途旅行;voyage指水上旅行、航行;excursion指结伴或团体短途旅行

ex.en: Air travel has made distant countries accessible to ordinary families.
ex.zh: 乘飞机旅行让普通家庭也能到达遥远的国家。

senses: v. 穿越;横穿;横越;穿过

ex.en: The hiking trail traverses dense forests and steep valleys before reaching the coast.
ex.zh: 这条远足路线穿越茂密的森林和陡峭的山谷，一直延伸到海岸。

ex.en: A waiter carried a tray of coffee cups into the meeting room.
ex.zh: 服务员端着一托盘咖啡走进会议室。

senses: n. 金银财宝；财富；宝物；心肝宝贝
treasure.usage: 派生treasurer n.司库,会计,财务主管；联想法：trea（“揣着”）+sure（当然）→揣着掖着，不想让外人看见，当然是宝贝→财富；宝物。；trea（音似“揣着”）+sure（当然）→揣着掖着不让外人看见→宝物

ex.en: This ring is my most treasured possession.
ex.zh: 这枚戒指是我最珍爱的财产。

ex.en: The Treasury expects government borrowing to fall as the economy gradually recovers.
ex.zh: 财政部预计，随着经济逐步复苏，政府借款将有所下降。

senses: ③款待，请客；n. 款待，请客
vt. 把…看作；款待；以…态度对待；处理；医治

phrases.m: 用某物治疗某人/某病症

treat.usage: 派生 treatment n. 待遇；处理；治疗；treatable adj. 可治愈的；v.对待，看待；治疗；招待；处 理 n.乐事；款待；索引p418

ex.en: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals.
ex.zh: 同样，孩子们也倾向于把机器人当成同类，即使它们只发出简单的社交信号。

ex.en: Doctors treated her burns with a new kind of ointment.
ex.zh: 医生用一种新药膏治疗她的烧伤。

ex.en: The article treats the problem of urban crime from an economic perspective.
ex.zh: 这篇文章从经济学视角探讨城市犯罪问题。

treaty.usage: [族]treat n. 对待；请客；辨析：treaty 国家间正式条约；convention 更专门化、欠正式；contract 双方或多方书面合同契约；40 好好背单词 这是我们的treaty；索引p418

ex.en: All the members have voted to ratify the treaty.
ex.zh: 所有成员都投赞成票通过了这一条约。

ex.en: The two nations signed a peace treaty after years of border conflicts.
ex.zh: 经过多年边界冲突后，两国签署了和平条约。

ex.en: Under the terms of the treaty, both sides must reduce their nuclear weapons.
ex.zh: 根据该条约条款，双方必须削减核武器。

ex.en: Old trees in urban parks are protected by local regulations.
ex.zh: 城市公园里的古树受地方法规保护。

senses: v. （因紧张、激动、惊慌等）颤抖，哆嗦，抖动，战栗；极担心；焦虑；恐惧
tremble.usage: 发音类似“穿薄”→一个人如果穿的衣服很薄，那冷风一吹，可能就要“颤抖，发抖”了→颤抖；哆嗦。；索引p418

ex.en: My legs were trembling with fear.
ex.zh: 我吓得双腿直发抖。

ex.en: Her voice trembled as she described the terrible scene.
ex.zh: 她在描述那可怕的一幕时声音颤抖。

ex.en: He trembled at the thought of speaking in front of the whole school.
ex.zh: 一想到要向全校师生演讲，他就不寒而栗。

senses: a. 巨大的；极大的；了不起的
adj. 极大的，巨大的；精彩的
tremendous.usage: 近义：enormous a. 巨大的；庞大的；派生tremendously adv.极大地；tre（tree树）+men（门）+d（的）+ous形容词后缀→这家门边有一棵“巨大的”树；谐音记忆："踹门打死"那个巨大的(tremendous)怪物。；索引p418

ex.en: A tremendous amount of work has gone into the project.
ex.zh: 大量的工作已投入到这项工程。

ex.en: a tremendous luxury
ex.zh: 一种巨大的奢侈

ex.en: The discovery of the vaccine had a tremendous impact on public health.
ex.zh: 疫苗的发现对公共卫生产生了巨大影响。

trench.usage: 辨析:trench既可指沟渠也可指战壕;ditch只能做沟渠,尤指蓄水或排水的沟渠

ex.en: Workers dug a deep trench to lay the new gas pipes.
ex.zh: 工人们挖了一条深沟来铺设新的燃气管道。

senses: n. 趋势，趋向，倾向；动态，动向
v. 朝着大方向变化或发展
trend.usage: 记：人们往往会(tend)察觉到这一趋势(trend)。扩：近 direction n. 趋势；辨析：tend 只用作动词；tide 潮流；direction 方向；派生 trendy adj./n. 时髦的(人)；n.趋势，趋向；风尚；热门话题；索引p418

ex.en: The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers.
ex.zh: 市场的运转基于潜在买家所支配的灵活趋势。

ex.en: The trend towards working from home has weakened demand for city-centre offices.
ex.zh: 居家办公的趋势削弱了对市中心写字楼的需求。

ex.en: Data from the past decade reveal a clear trend: people are marrying later and having fewer children.
ex.zh: 过去十年的数据显示出一个清晰的趋势：人们结婚更晚，生育更少。

senses: n. 审讯，审判；试用，试验

phrases.m: 奥林匹克运动会选拔赛

phrases.p: bring sb. to/up for a trial

trial.usage: vt. 试用；试验，如 trial the materials 试用材料。记：他因窃取他人的试验成果而受到了法院的审判。近：test n. 试验；词组stand(undergo)(one's)trial for因……而受审;put sth. to trial试验某物以检测其质量/效能；n.审判；试验，试用；考验， 磨练

ex.en: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts", or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
ex.zh: 最高法院在裁决中称，有一件事审判麦克唐纳诉讼案的法官没有告知陪审团：陪审团必须只关注麦克唐纳的"官方行为"，或是只关注这位前州长在其职责相关的"特定的"和"待定的"问题上所做出的决定。

ex.en: The new drug performed well in early trials but failed in large-scale human testing.
ex.zh: 这种新药在早期试验中表现良好，却在大型人体测试中失败。

ex.en: The trial lasted six weeks, and the jury heard from more than thirty witnesses.
ex.zh: 庭审持续了六周，陪审团听取了三十多名证人的证词。

senses: n. 三角形;三角关系(尤指男女间的)
triangle.usage: 助记:tri(三个)+angle(角)→三角形;equilateral等边三角形/obtuse钝角三角形/right-angled直角三角形

ex.en: The novel centres on a love triangle among three university students.
ex.zh: 这部小说以三名大学生之间的三角恋爱为主线。

ex.en: The museum's new exhibition explores tribal art from the Amazon basin.
ex.zh: 博物馆的新展览探索亚马逊流域的部落艺术。

ex.en: The tribe has lived in the rainforest for thousands of years.
ex.zh: 这个部落在雨林中生活了数千年。

ex.en: Regular exercise contributes significantly to both physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼对身心健康都大有裨益。

senses: n. 技巧,窍门;戏弄,恶作剧
trick.usage: 词组try a trick耍花招；n.花招，诡计；窍门；戏法 v.欺骗，哄骗 adj.骗人的；虚弱的，有毛病 的；串词记忆：在旁边的小路(track)上耍花招(trick)。；索引p418

ex.en: The trick is to direct these funds better.
ex.zh: 诀窍在于要监管好这些基金的使用。

ex.en: The salesman used all kinds of tricks to persuade customers to buy.
ex.zh: 推销员用尽各种花招劝顾客购买。

ex.en: He tricked the old lady into signing a contract she did not understand.
ex.zh: 他骗老太太签了一份她看不懂的合同。

ex.en: Reports of the scandal began to trickle out despite the government's efforts at censorship.
ex.zh: 尽管政府试图封锁消息，有关这桩丑闻的报道仍开始零星传出。

ex.en: But defining what it means to be a good parent is undoubtedly very tricky, particularly since children respond differently to the same style of parenting.
ex.zh: 但是，要定义什么才是好父母无疑很难，尤其是因为孩子们对相同的教养方式反应会不同。

senses: v. 开玩笑,小看;(with)戏弄,玩弄;(away)浪费
trifle.usage: 同义trivia;助记:为了一件trifle(小事)他就拿起了rifle(步枪)

ex.en: Effective managers refuse to waste time on trifles and focus on key decisions.
ex.zh: 高效的管理者拒绝把时间浪费在琐事上，而是专注于关键决策。

senses: n. [C] （尤指引发不良后果的）起因
trigger.usage: 记：别再调查这件事的起因了，这可能会引起一系列事情。；索引p418

ex.en: In people who score high in a test of neuroticism, a personality dimension associated with self-consciousness and anxiety, eye contact triggered more activity associated with avoidance, according to the Finnish researcher Jari Hietanen and colleagues.
ex.zh: 神经质是一种与自我意识和焦虑相关的人格维度，根据芬兰研究员亚里·希耶塔宁及其同事的研究，对于在神经质测试中得分高的人，眼神接触会引发更多与回避相关的举动。

senses: adj. 整齐的,整洁的;苗条的,修长的
v. 整理,修理,装饰;调整,削减
n. 整齐,整洁;调整,准备;修剪
trim.usage: 助记:把杯子rim(周缘)清洗trim(整洁);派生trimly adv.整齐地,井然有序地

ex.en: The company trimmed its workforce to cut costs during the recession.
ex.zh: 经济衰退期间，公司裁减员工以降低成本。

senses: v. (on,over)绊倒;使失误,使犯错误;(up)使绊倒;使失误,使失败

ex.en: The school organises an annual trip to a historic city for its students.
ex.zh: 学校每年为学生组织一次前往历史名城的旅行。

senses: adj. 三倍的,三重的,三部分的,三方的
triple.usage: tri（表示“三”）+ple（=part，部分）→三部分的，三倍的。

senses: n. 胜利,非凡的成功,杰出的成就
n. (胜利或成功的)喜悦,狂喜
n. 巨大成功，重大成就，伟大胜利；（巨大成功或胜利的）心满意足，喜悦，狂喜
triumph.usage: triumph现常指借喻性胜利;军事上的胜利用victory不可用triumph;反义defeat n.失败,失利；吹响喇叭(trumpet)庆祝取得的伟大胜利(triumph)；索引p418

ex.en: In both oral and written English, talking is triumphing over speaking, spontaneity over craft.
ex.zh: 在口语和书面英语中，（随意的）谈话胜于（正式的）发言，即兴发挥也胜过了精雕细琢。

ex.en: Winning the gold medal was the greatest triumph of her career.
ex.zh: 赢得金牌是她职业生涯最辉煌的胜利。

ex.en: Justice finally triumphed after ten years of legal struggle.
ex.zh: 经过十年的诉讼抗争，正义终获胜利。

senses: adj. 琐碎的,不重要的,无价值的
adj. 琐碎的；不重要的，微不足道的

phrases.m: n. 无关紧要的事物,细节或信息

trivial.usage: 反义significant adj.重大的,重要的;典型考题quarrel for such__matters选B.trivial(small/tiny指体积,minor次要)；tri(三)+vi(发音类似way"道路")+al(形容词后缀)→三岔路口的闲聊→琐碎的；不重要的；索引p418

ex.en: Apparently trivial clues may turn out to be quite important.
ex.zh: 看似微不足道的线索实际上可能相当重要。

ex.en: Don't waste the meeting's time on trivial details.
ex.zh: 不要把会议时间浪费在琐碎的细节上。

ex.en: The manager dismissed my suggestion as trivial and unworkable.
ex.zh: 经理认为我的建议无关紧要、不可行，不予理会。

ex.en: He refused to waste the meeting's limited time on trivialities and moved straight to the budget.
ex.zh: 他拒绝把会议有限的时间浪费在琐事上，直接转入预算议题。

ex.en: Shoppers are encouraged to return their trolleys to the designated areas after use.
ex.zh: 商场鼓励购物者用完手推车后将其放回指定区域。

ex.en: The waiter wheeled a dessert trolley between the crowded restaurant tables.
ex.zh: 侍者推着甜点手推车，穿梭于餐厅拥挤的餐桌之间。

ex.en: The government decided to withdraw its troops from the conflict zone.
ex.zh: 政府决定从冲突地区撤军。

ex.en: The island lies close to the Tropic of Cancer, so daylight barely changes with the seasons.
ex.zh: 该岛靠近北回归线，因此白昼长短几乎不随季节变化。

ex.en: Tropical forests are disappearing at an alarming rate.
ex.zh: 热带森林正以惊人的速度消失。

ex.en: They have trouble seeing a financial future and they are quite risk averse.
ex.zh: 他们很难预见财务前景，而且非常厌恶风险。

senses: n. 惹事生非者,闹事者

ex.en: Teachers should guide potential troublemakers rather than simply punish them.
ex.zh: 教师应引导潜在的闹事者，而不是简单地惩罚他们。

senses: adj. 令人烦恼的,讨厌的
n. (演员、歌手等的)班子,表演团

ex.en: The dance troupe will tour twelve cities before finally returning home.
ex.zh: 舞蹈团将巡演十二座城市，然后才最终回国。

ex.en: Several airlines now allow female crew members to wear trousers on duty.
ex.zh: 几家航空公司现在允许女性机组人员上班时穿长裤。

ex.en: The two sides agreed to a brief truce, allowing aid convoys to reach the flooded villages.
ex.zh: 双方同意短暂停战，使救援车队得以抵达被洪水围困的村庄。

ex.en: The goods were loaded onto a truck bound for the port.
ex.zh: 货物被装上一辆开往港口的卡车。

senses: a. 符合事实的；确实的；实质的
true.usage: 派生 truly adv. 真诚地,诚恳地

ex.en: It remains true that regular reading broadens the mind.
ex.zh: 经常阅读能开阔视野，这一点依然成立。

ex.en: The new policy will be truly effective only if it is enforced consistently.
ex.zh: 只有持续严格执行，新政策才会真正有效。

ex.en: Questionnaires remain a common instrument for collecting data in social surveys.
ex.zh: 问卷仍然是社会调查中收集数据的常用工具。

ex.en: The sound of a trumpet announced the start of the ceremony.
ex.zh: 号声宣告仪式开始。

senses: n. [C] 树干；后备箱；大衣箱

ex.en: The ancient tree has a trunk so wide that four adults can barely encircle it.
ex.zh: 这棵古树树干极粗，四个成年人勉强能合抱。

senses: vt. 信任；信赖；认为可靠
n. 相信；信托；受托基金机构；委托
trust.usage: n.信任，信赖；信托 v.信任，相信；trust in信任；依靠；索引p418

ex.en: A good partnership is built on mutual trust rather than contracts alone.
ex.zh: 良好的伙伴关系建立在相互信任之上，而不是仅靠合同。

ex.en: You can trust her to keep the secret; she has never let anyone down.
ex.zh: 你可以放心她会保守秘密，她从未让任何人失望。

ex.en: Public trust in the media has declined sharply in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来，公众对媒体的信任急剧下降。

ex.en: Consumers judge a brand's trustworthiness largely by its after-sales service.
ex.zh: 消费者主要通过售后服务来判断一个品牌的可信度。

ex.en: Before signing the contract, the firm checked whether the supplier was trustworthy.
ex.zh: 签订合同之前，这家公司核实了供应商是否值得信赖。

senses: n. 真实,真相,真理,真实性

ex.en: In theory, the success of an applicant should not depend on the few others chosen randomly for interview during the same day, but Dr. Simonsohn suspected the truth was otherwise.
ex.zh: 从理论上讲，一名申请者能否被成功录取不应取决于在同一天被随机选来面试的其他几名申请者，但西蒙松博士却怀疑实际情况并非如此。

ex.en: Faced with falling sales, the firm decided to try a new marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 面对销售下滑，该公司决定尝试新的营销策略。

ex.en: She soaked in a hot tub after a long day of hiking.
ex.zh: 远足了一整天后，她泡在热水浴缸里放松。

senses: n. 管,软管,电子管,显像管

ex.en: Millions of Londoners travel to work on the Tube every morning.
ex.zh: 数百万伦敦人每天早晨乘地铁去上班。

ex.en: His attitude towards criticism largely determines how quickly he improves.
ex.zh: 他对批评的态度在很大程度上决定了他进步的快慢。

ex.en: The lecture has been moved from Tuesday to Friday because of the public holiday.
ex.zh: 由于法定假日，讲座已从星期二改到星期五。

ex.en: The museum offers free admission every Tuesday of the month.
ex.zh: 博物馆每周二免费开放。

ex.en: He gave the rope a sharp tug and the knot came loose.
ex.zh: 他猛地一拉绳子，绳结便松开了。

senses: n. 学费,(尤指对个人的)教学,讲授,指导
tuition.usage: [近]instruction n. 讲授；n.教学；学费；发音类似“推身”→想参加特长班又不好意思问“学费”多少，就推着朋友让他帮你问→学费。

ex.en: Few can afford the tuition of $10,000 a term.
ex.zh: 很少有人能够付得起一学期1万美元的学费。

ex.en: The government plans to raise tuition fees at public universities.
ex.zh: 政府计划提高公立大学的学费。

ex.en: He paid off his tuition loans within five years of graduation.
ex.zh: 毕业五年内，他还清了学费贷款。

ex.en: Every spring, millions of tulips draw visitors to the city's famous gardens.
ex.zh: 每年春天，数百万株郁金香吸引游客来到这座城市著名的花园。

senses: vi. 跌倒，滚下；（价格等）暴跌
v. (价格等)暴跌,(权利、地位等)急剧下降
v. 打滚,翻滚;n. 摔倒,跌跤;暴跌,下降

ex.en: Share prices tumbled after the company reported huge losses.
ex.zh: 该公司公布巨额亏损后，股价暴跌。

ex.en: Doctors found a small tumour during a routine medical examination.
ex.zh: 医生在常规体检中发现了一个小肿瘤。

senses: vt. 调音,调整,调节,使和谐

ex.en: He hummed a cheerful tune while preparing breakfast.
ex.zh: 他哼着欢快的小调准备早餐。

tunnel.usage: 记：为了避免隧道破坏原始地质结构，工程师需要研究开凿隧道的路线。

ex.en: The railway tunnel under the mountains shortened the journey by several hours.
ex.zh: 穿越群山的铁路隧道把旅程缩短了好几个小时。

ex.en: Wind turbines now supply a growing share of the country's electricity.
ex.zh: 风力涡轮机如今供应着该国越来越大的电力份额。

senses: n. [U] 动荡；骚乱；(空气和水的)湍流，涡流，紊流

ex.en: Political turbulence has discouraged foreign investment in the region.
ex.zh: 政治动荡使外国投资者对该地区望而却步。

senses: adj. 骚乱的,动荡的,混乱的,狂暴的
adj. (指空气或水)流动得猛烈而不稳定的
adj. 动荡的；猛烈的；湍急的
turbulent.usage: 同义violent,disorderly,furious；词根记忆: turb(agitate, 搅动)+ul+ent(形容词后缀)→搅动不安的→动荡的；索引p418

ex.en: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
ex.zh: 同时，动荡的商业环境也使得高管们格外小心，避免让模糊不清的表态有损自己的名誉。

senses: 表与行为有关之物，名词词性

ex.en: Furniture made from recycled materials is gaining popularity among young consumers.
ex.zh: 用回收材料制造的家具越来越受年轻消费者的欢迎。

senses: n. 失败,失败的人或事物

ex.en: Roast turkey is traditionally served at Thanksgiving dinners in America.
ex.zh: 在美国，烤火鸡是感恩节晚餐的传统菜肴。

ex.en: Turkey, officially known as Türkiye, occupies land on both the European and Asian continents.
ex.zh: 土耳其（官方名称为Türkiye）地跨欧亚两洲。

senses: n. 动乱,骚动,混乱,焦虑

ex.en: The country was thrown into political turmoil after the disputed election.
ex.zh: 争议选举之后，该国陷入政治动荡。

senses: v. 翻动,翻转;变得,变成
n. 转动,旋转;翻转,转变;变化;(轮流时)一次机会
v. 转身；（使）变成；转动；翻转；转弯

phrases.m: 依次地,轮流地;转而,反过来
开大,调大;出现,来到;(尤指意外地)发生

phrases.p: have a turn in the most favourable positions
phrases.m: 轮流利用最有利的位置

turn.usage: turn in上交,交还;turn into变成;turn off关掉;turn out制造,生产;结果是;turn over翻转;交给,移交；索引p418

senses: n. [常用sing.] 好转；周转期；彻底转变
n. 好转,起色,转机;(观点、行为等的)彻底转变
n. (接活到交活之间的)周转期,时限;(轮船、飞机的)终点装卸时间
n. （观点、态度或方法的）彻底转变；周转期

ex.en: One reason for the turnaround may be the country's antipoverty program.
ex.zh: 该国的反贫困计划可能是导致这一转变的一个原因。

senses: n. 成交量,营业额;(资金等)周转
n. 货物周转率；（人员的）流动率；营业额

ex.en: Volunteers patrol the beach at night to protect nesting sea turtles from disturbance.
ex.zh: 志愿者夜间在海滩巡逻，保护筑巢的海龟免受干扰。

senses: n. 家庭教师,指导教师
tutor.usage: tut（保护；指导，教育）+or（表示“人”的名词后缀）→指导的人，教育的人→导师，指导教师。

ex.en: He can serve as the woman's tutor.
ex.zh: 他可以担任该女士的指导教师。

ex.en: The documentary will be broadcast on national TV next month.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片将于下月在国家电视台播出。

ex.en: Television remains a powerful medium for shaping public opinion despite the rise of streaming services.
ex.zh: 尽管流媒体服务兴起，电视仍是塑造公众舆论的有力媒介。

ex.en: The course is divided into twelve modules, each lasting two weeks.
ex.zh: 这门课程分为十二个模块，每个模块持续两周。

ex.en: Over the past twenty years, tourism has transformed the quiet village.
ex.zh: 过去二十年里，旅游业使这个宁静的村庄彻底改观。

ex.en: The company has twice delayed the launch of its new phone.
ex.zh: 该公司已两次推迟新款手机的发布。

senses: a. 双胞胎之一的；成对的；双重的
adj. 双的,成对的,孪生的
adj. 同时出现的,密切相关的

ex.en: Studies of identical twins help scientists separate genetic factors from environmental ones.
ex.zh: 对同卵双胞胎的研究帮助科学家区分遗传因素与环境因素。

senses: n. 闪烁；闪亮；欣喜的神情
twinkle.usage: 儿时的一首歌：twinkle twinkle little star 一闪一闪亮晶晶→闪烁

ex.en: Stars twinkled in the sky.
ex.zh: 星星在天空中闪烁。

senses: n. [C] 转折，转变，突然变化
n. 拧,捻,搓,绞;曲解,歪曲
n. 曲折处；转动；(故事或情况的)转折

phrases.m: adj. 反常的,变态的,扭曲的

twist.usage: 记：在这条路的急转弯处发生的意外使我的人生发生了转折。；索引p418

ex.en: Whichever it is, you know every twist and turn like the back of your hand.
ex.zh: 不管是哪条(路)，你对它的每一处迂回曲折都了如指掌。

ex.en: The sparrows' cheerful twitter filled the garden on that quiet spring morning.
ex.zh: 那个宁静的春日清晨，麻雀欢快的啁啾声充满了花园。

ex.en: The two sides failed to reach an agreement after months of talks.
ex.zh: 经过数月谈判，双方未能达成协议。

ex.en: Honesty and reliability are qualities that employers value most in new hires.
ex.zh: 诚实和可靠是雇主在招聘新员工时最看重的品质。

ex.en: This study is typical of recent research on the link between sleep and memory.
ex.zh: 这项研究是近期有关睡眠与记忆关联研究的典型代表。

senses: n. [sing.] 具有某种特征的人
v. 分型,定型,测定……的类型;打字
type.usage: n.类型，种类 v.打字；测定……的类型，分 型；索引p418

ex.en: This type of battery performs well even at low temperatures.
ex.zh: 这种类型的电池即使在低温下也表现良好。

ex.en: She is not the type to give up halfway.
ex.zh: 她不是那种半途而废的人。

ex.en: He can type over eighty words per minute without looking at the keyboard.
ex.zh: 他不看键盘每分钟能打八十多个单词。
